description: FDA: number assigned to a specific recall event, for tracking.
FDA: firm that initiated the recall, or that is primarily responsible for the product.
FDA hazard class: Class I (could cause serious health problems or death), Class II (temporary or reversible problems, or remote chance of serious ones), Class III (unlikely to cause harm).
FDA recall status: Ongoing, Completed, Terminated (or Pending).
FDA: how the product is defective or violates the law. Phone numbers are removed by DataForge.
FDA: brief description of the recalled product. Phone numbers are removed by DataForge.
